worldcombat.skill.mudshot.summary: Press a blob of wet mud flat and hurl it skimming the ground: it flies flat and wide, bursts at the target's feet, and the spray coats the legs of every foe in the splash, dropping their Speed; only a short mud smear stays where it lands. Wide Spray coats a broader, deeper-slow area for a lighter and shorter cast.
worldcombat.skill.mudshot.description.0: The clod bursts where it lands: a living hit deals about %1$s special damage to the main target, and every foe caught in the %2$s block spray loses %3$s Speed stage(s) (other combatants take it on their movement speed); those caught only by the spray are mired but take none of that damage.
worldcombat.skill.mudshot.description.1: The clod flies at %1$s blocks per tick, out to %2$s blocks, with a %3$s block hit radius.
worldcombat.skill.mudshot.description.2: The Speed a mired body loses stays through the encounter until the stat change is cleared or the encounter ends; the mired mark on the main target lasts %1$s and the mud smear on the ground then fades.
worldcombat.skill.mudshot.wide.on: Wide Spray: a broader splash, one more Speed stage and a longer-lived smear, at the cost of a lighter blow, shorter reach and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.mudshot.wide.off: Point cast: a heavier, longer, faster clod that only coats the small circle at its feet.
worldcombat.skill.mudshot.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.mudshot.growth.0: From level %1$s the mud rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.mudshot.growth.1: From level %1$s the mud rises to %2$s and the mire lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.mudshot.use.0: Drop a quick runner's Speed at mid range
worldcombat.skill.mudshot.use.1: Mire the legs first, then finish with a heavier move
worldcombat.skill.mudshot.use.2: Slow a whole cluster around the target
worldcombat.skill.mudshot.preference.wid: On: a broader splash, one more Speed stage and a longer-lived smear, at the cost of a lighter blow, shorter reach and a longer cooldown. Off: a heavier, farther, faster clod that only coats the small circle at its feet.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of throwing. Larger values open with the mire from further out.
On: prefer a fast-moving target, pinning its Speed down first. Off: treat it as an ordinary mid-range candidate.
